name: Closeprofitendofweek
summary: This EA is a utility that automatically closes all profitable positions for the current symbol on Friday after a user-specified end time. It operates via a timer and skips crypto symbols. It does not open any trades itself, functioning purely as an end-of-week profit-taking manager.
summary_zh: 该EA是一个工具型程序，在周五用户指定的结束时间后自动平掉当前品种所有盈利仓位。它通过定时器运行，跳过加密货币品种，本身不开仓，仅作为周末利润管理工具。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略概念是在周五交易时段结束时自动关闭所有盈利仓位，以避免周末持仓风险。入场条件方面，该EA不执行任何入场操作，仅负责出场管理。出场条件为：当前时间为周五且服务器时间已超过用户设定的Endtrade时间，且持仓浮盈大于零。仓位管理方面，该EA不涉及开仓仓位管理，仅对已有仓位进行选择性平仓（仅平盈利仓）。资金管理方面，没有任何资金管理逻辑，不根据账户余额或风险比例调整操作。此外，该EA通过SYMBOL_CATEGORY过滤掉加密货币品种，且仅针对当前图表品种进行操作，使用定时器触发而非OnTick事件。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept of this EA is to automatically close all profitable positions at the end of Friday's trading session to avoid weekend holding risk. Regarding entry conditions, this EA does not execute any entries; it only manages exits. The exit condition is: the current day is Friday, the server time has passed the user-defined Endtrade time, and the position has a floating profit greater than zero. In terms of position sizing, this EA does not handle opening positions; it only selectively closes existing profitable ones. For money management, there is no money management logic at all—no adjustments based on account balance or risk ratios. Additionally, the EA filters out crypto symbols via SYMBOL_CATEGORY, operates only on the current chart symbol, and uses a timer trigger instead of the OnTick event, which means it may miss positions if the timer interval is not configured properly.

parameters.name: Closetradeatendtime
parameters.description: 是否在结束时间和周末关闭所有盈利仓位
parameters.description_en: Close all profitable positions at end time and weekends

pros: 逻辑简单明了，专注于周末风险管理，减少持仓过周末的风险
仅平仓盈利仓位，保留亏损仓位让交易者自行决定，避免锁定亏损
通过品种类别过滤跳过加密货币，考虑了7×24市场的特殊性
使用CTrade标准库进行平仓操作，代码规范可靠
pros_en: Simple and clear logic focused on weekend risk management, reducing exposure to weekend gap risk
Only closes profitable positions, leaving losing positions for the trader to decide, avoiding locked-in losses
Filters out crypto symbols via category check, acknowledging that crypto trades 24/7
Uses standard CTrade library for closing operations, ensuring reliable and规范的execution
cons: 仅在OnTimer中运行，若未正确设置定时器间隔则可能错过平仓时机
只平盈利仓不平亏损仓，可能导致账户仍持有亏损仓位过周末面临跳空风险
没有重试机制，平仓失败后仅打印日志而不进行再次尝试
Starttrade参数声明了但从未使用，属于无效参数
遍历仓位时使用索引而非从后向前遍历，平仓后可能导致索引错乱
cons_en: Only runs in OnTimer, meaning it may miss closing opportunities if the timer interval is not properly configured
Only closes profitable positions while leaving losing ones open, which still exposes the account to weekend gap risk
No retry mechanism—if closing fails, it only prints a log without attempting again
The Starttrade parameter is declared but never used, making it a dead parameter
Iterates positions by index from front to back; closing positions during iteration may cause index shifting issues
improvements: 应从后向前遍历仓位列表（从PositionsTotal()-1到0），避免平仓后索引错乱导致跳过仓位
移除未使用的Starttrade参数或实现其功能，增加OnTimer中EventSetTimer的初始化设置
增加平仓失败重试机制，并考虑同时提供关闭亏损仓位的选项以全面规避周末风险
improvements_en: Iterate positions from back to front (PositionsTotal()-1 down to 0) to avoid index shifting when positions are closed during iteration
Remove the unused Starttrade parameter or implement its functionality, and add EventSetTimer initialization in OnInit
Add a retry mechanism for failed close attempts, and consider providing an option to also close losing positions for comprehensive weekend risk avoidance

risk_points: 从前往后遍历仓位列表时平仓可能导致索引错乱，跳过部分仓位
OnTimer未在OnInit中初始化，若未手动设置定时器则EA不会执行任何操作
risk_points_en: Iterating positions from front to back while closing may cause index shifting, potentially skipping some positions
OnTimer is not initialized in OnInit; if the timer is not manually set, the EA will not execute any operations

summary_en: This EA is a utility that automatically closes all profitable positions for the current symbol on Friday after a user-specified end time. It operates via a timer and skips crypto symbols. It does not open any trades itself, functioning purely as an end-of-week profit-taking manager.
